schema: MOON x CYCLONE TERMINAL AI v10.0 master integration task ledger

project.core: MOON Core (Orchestrator, agents, tools, skills, memory, models)

findings: MOON is a self-hosted autonomous AI agent (python package moon-ai-agent; main.py, app/, moon/; FastAPI at app/terminal_interface.py on :8777; 41 built-in agents, 40+ tools, advanced memory, 4 model backends).

CYCLONE v10.0 is a Node.js terminal (server.js, app.js, index.html, styles.css, test.js, config.js, package.json, README.md) at CYCLONE_TERMINAL_AI_V10/, server on 127.0.0.1:8765, browser UI at :8765.

Existing MOON bridge in app/terminal_interface.py (lines 2512-2564) is an INERT stub: it imports a nonexistent Python 'cyclone' package and mounts it at /cyclone. It never activated for the real Node.js CYCLONE. Integration is therefore MISSING and must be rebuilt on a stable HTTP bridge.

MOON Application Interface already exposes /api/{health,settings,capabilities,agents,tools,events,factory,agents/{id}/run,memory,knowledge/search,tasks,executions,metrics,supervision,brains,brain-stats,logs,voice}. Missing: /api/terminal control surface, /api/skills, /api/run, version endpoint.
MOON skills: app/runtime/skill_system.py + app/skills/advanced/* + project skills/ dir.
MOON tools: app/tools/*.py registered in the Orchestrator _tools._registry.
MOON models: AgentModelManager + settings (MODEL_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1, MODEL_NAME=qwen3:0.6b; OPENAI/OPENROUTER/HF fallbacks).
MOON memory: app/memory/* (CognitiveMemoryManager) with MemoryHealthService terminal_status (spec 59).
Preservation: no files deleted, all existing agents/tools/skills/memory/models/services retained. CYCLONE retained as primary terminal. No secrets committed, .env gitignored.

capabilities.verify: GET /api/agents returns live agent roster and POST /api/agents/{id}/run executes a task
GET /api/health returns CYCLONE health; browser UI loads

decisions: Integration mechanism: HTTP REST bridge (CYCLONE Node server on :8765 -> MOON FastAPI Application Interface on :8777). No rewriting of either component.

The dead Python 'cyclone' stub in app/terminal_interface.py (lines 2512-2564) is inert and references a nonexistent module; it will be removed so startup logs are clean and no misleading 'bridge disabled' warning is emitted.
MOON Application Interface endpoints are exposed as a public local surface (like the existing /api/health and /api/agents) so CYCLONE's bridge can call them out-of-the-box on the same machine.
All existing MOON agents/tools/memory/models/services are retained; integration is additive.
Secrets: none committed; .env is gitignored; API keys remain in operator environment or MOON .env (gitignored).
